suggestionContent:
**Per-entry shares check makes same-label entries disagree on id**

Two entries for one model can now render differently—one with its id, one plain—so Routing shows the plain one naming no connection. Decide the id once per `byLabel` group, as `needsId` does, rather than per entry in `shares`.
label: bug

suggestionContent:
**Added picker case asserts shared-label ids that already worked before the fix**

The picker already appended ids for shared labels before this PR, so this case passes on both revisions and guards nothing. Assert the page-computed `lockedLabel` or a caller that uses `modelLabeler` instead.
label: kody_rules

suggestionContent:
**Locked-label test injects expected label, no longer drives page derivation**

Injecting the finished `lockedLabel` only checks that `ModelLockedField` renders the string it is given. The page derivation in `page.client.tsx` (`visibleModelLabels(existing).get(editModelId ?? "") ?? formatModelLabel(existingConfig.model)`) can silently fall back to the id-less label and still pass; drive that lookup instead.
label: bug
